owner: firmware track (the numbers, from the bench: docs/dev/battery-and-power.md); the playground track reads this file (scripts/virtual-unit/power_model.py)
note: Every number is a placeholder (basis assumed) until the bench measures it. The unit reads a battery percent and no battery current, so the real figures come from the level against time at a known load. Replace a value, set its status to measured and give its source; nothing else changes.

battery.source: a typical single cell of this class of unit; the capacity is not in the code (docs/dev/battery-and-power.md section 1)

charge.source: the unit sets 700 mA constant current at start (register 0x62); the taper is the usual shape of a constant-voltage phase

loads_ma.what: processor, screen at half brightness, face drawing, Wi-Fi on and idle
extra for the screen at full brightness (scales with the level)
microphones and the wake word listening
the speaker amplifier while a voice or a sound plays
both servos powered and holding still
extra for each servo that is moving
the camera and the face finder while a look runs
the light ring at full white (scales with the average level)
less when the screen is off (asleep)

usual.what: a household day: face on, host paired, a little talking, a few head moves

always_listening.what: voice on all day with a camera look now and then

desk.what: on a desk with the screen dimmed and no host
